scope: Bounded live empirical benchmark querying Finnish PRH YTJ-API v3 and live public company websites across 3 distinct industrial sectors (Cloud IT/62, Fabricated Metal/25, Machinery/28). Enforces normal TLS, active OY entity validation, refresh=True, bounded safe HTTP fetching, SHA-256 cryptographic provenance hashing, and isolated cache storage in benchmarks/cache.
limitations: Provider filtering can return nonmatching current sectors; collector enforces current mainBusinessLine prefix locally. Provider total_candidates is not the count passing this local filter.
PRH name searches can match auxiliary and historical names; they do not index all company website text.
Website presence is dependent on official registry URL filings; missing or outdated registry URLs lead to unexamined candidates without reflecting real business viability.
Keyword coverage measures public web prose alignment with advisor-defined search heuristics; it does NOT indicate acquisition suitability, transaction readiness, or commercial fitness.

Corporate-change terms ('acquired by', 'yhdistivÃ¤t voimansa', etc.) act strictly as advisory review triggers to prevent treating subsidiaries as independent targets, not as confirmed ownership status.
Web fetching uses standard TLS with a strict 7-second timeout and 1 MB ceiling; bot-protection (Cloudflare/CAPTCHA), geo-blocking, or slow hosting may result in unreachability.
